product.name: Sonauto AI Music Generation API
product.description: An API that generates complete songs from prompts, lyrics, or tags, supporting various musical styles and output formats.

product.name: Song Extension Service
product.description: A service to extend existing songs by adding new audio segments to the start or end of a track using AI generation.

product.name: Audio Inpainting Service
product.description: A service that replaces specified sections of an existing audio track with newly generated content based on user inputs.

product.name: Sonauto AI Music Web Platform
product.description: A web-based platform for users to generate, manage, and listen to AI-created music tracks and playlists.

product.name: Was This Made With Treblo?
